event: Adaeze Okonkwo does Marisol Vasquez a favour that costs them something real.

name: Adaeze Okonkwo
action: stirrs in bed and sits up
thought: I still have time to see one of my sons make a change.

name: Junie Marsh
action: stretches and arches back, yawns
thought: What if I'm stuck here forever?

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: stays in bed, avoiding looking at his alarm clock
thought: I wish I could get out from under Lyle's thumb.

name: Rey Vasquez
action: lies still, eyes open, thinking
thought: My wife's smile when I came home from work last night.

name: Marisol Vasquez
action: remains still, looking out into the fog
thought: Vasquez will leave this house one day.

name: Gus Petrakis
action: stays in bed, hands clasped behind head
thought: I wish Dez would leave us alone.

name: Malik Reyes
action: sits up, eyes scanning the darkness
thought: I need to take down Dez and Lyle.

name: Wes Doyle
action: rolls over, avoiding thinking
thought: I need to escape Lyle's clutches.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: stays in bed, eyes closed
thought: Booker is involved in something shady.

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: stretches, then settles in
thought: Amara's ready to take over the diner.

name: Sticks
action: lies still, eyes closed
thought: Marcus is kind and compassionate.

name: Cass Deveaux
belief: Deal will be made before anyone else figures out who's buying

name: Gus Petrakis
belief: Dez is trying to take over the block

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
belief: Lyle is not what he seems

name: Malik Reyes
belief: Dez and Lyle are conspiring against me

event: The 9th kicks a door on Riverside. Wrong door, as it turns out.

name: Junie Marsh
action: leans against the counter, exhausted
thought: Why can't I ever just escape?

speech.text: Just a minute, Nadia, I need to catch my breath.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: counts out change again
thought: I've got to get out of this, it's not sustainable

speech.text: Can I help you find something, Mr...?

name: Sticks
action: kicks at the gravel some more
thought: If people only saw me, they'd know I'm still here

speech.text: Just another rainy day, huh?

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: tells a joke to the group
thought: I wish Father was here to see this

speech.text: Hey, Junie, why did the waitress bring a ladder to work?

name: Ms. Ivy Calloway
action: signs for a delivery
thought: This rain's not going to make things any easier

speech.text: You're looking for something, Mr...?

name: Gus Petrakis
action: pours coffee for someone
thought: I've got to talk to Okonkwo about this

speech.text: Just a coffee, Yolanda, on the house.

name: Malik Reyes
action: sits down for a minute
thought: I've got to get out from under Okonkwo's control

name: Rey Vasquez
action: signs for a delivery
thought: I just want to retire clean

name: Cass Deveaux
action: browses the shelves
thought: I've got to protect the block's interests

speech.text: Just a minute, Ms. Calloway, I need to find something.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: gets a haircut
thought: I need to crack this case

speech.text: Make it snappy, Gus.

name: Dr. Yusuf Amin
action: makes bad coffee
thought: I really need a second doctor or a week off

speech.text: Just a minute, Simone, I need to fix this.

event: Ofc. Brady Kohl pulls a file that should have been closed years ago and cannot put it back.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: stared blankly at the file on his desk
thought: I should just put it back, but something about it bothers me

name: Malik Reyes
action: glared at Amara
thought: Why can't anyone just get this right for one day?

speech.text: Your brother should've paid more attention

name: Junie Marsh
action: tried to catch Simone's eye
thought: I wonder if anyone would even notice if I just packed up and left

speech.text: Hey, do you think it's really that bad outside?

name: Rey Vasquez
action: reorganized his toolbox
thought: I'll get out from under this debt eventually

speech.text: Hey, how's it going?

name: Sticks
action: pulled out a small notebook
thought: I should write down all the things people say to me that make me feel seen

name: Wes Doyle
action: picked at the fabric of his shirt
thought: I hate being beholden to Lyle like this

speech.text: What's up, Marcus?

name: Booker Lyle
action: chuckled at something Cass said
thought: Dez will come crawling to me eventually, I just know it

speech.text: Ha! Yeah, I know what you mean, Cass

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: poured himself a glass of water
thought: I just need to keep my head down and wait for this to blow over

name: Simone Adeyemi
action: patted Junie's hand
thought: I'm not sure how much more of this I can take

speech.text: Hey, don't worry, Junie, it'll be okay

name: Amara Bello
action: rolled her eyes at Malik
thought: My brother has no idea what he's doing

speech.text: Come on, Malik, it's not that hard

name: Gus Petrakis
action: wiped down the counter
thought: I just wish someone would take care of this mess for me

speech.text: Hey, Tee, can you take over for a minute?

event: An ambulance takes someone out of the Terraces before dawn. Nobody says a name.

name: Junie Marsh
action: stirring in bed
thought: another night, another chance to get away

speech.text: Hey, Det. Ruiz, how'd you sleep?

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: opening his eyes to look at Gus Petrakis
thought: what am I doing still in this apartment?

speech.text: Morning, Gus. How'd you sleep?

name: Rey Vasquez
action: waking up and getting out of bed
thought: I have to get to the shop today, can't be late.

speech.text: Hey, honey, how'd you sleep?

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: stretching in bed
thought: I'll talk to Amara today about the diner.

speech.text: Morning, kiddo, ready to take over the world?

name: Gus Petrakis
action: snoring softly, dozing off
thought: I'm getting too old for this.

name: Malik Reyes
action: lying awake, staring at the ceiling
thought: Dez is secretly working with Lyle to take me down.

name: Wes Doyle
action: trying to fall back asleep
thought: Lyle will kill me if I don't play by his rules.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: lying awake, thinking about the case
thought: I need to talk to Junie again about Booker.

name: Simone Adeyemi
action: stirring in bed
thought: I need to talk to Ruiz about Booker.

speech.text: Morning, Det. Ruiz. How'd you sleep?

name: Sticks
action: watching the street from under the flyover
thought: I wonder what's going on at the Terraces.

name: Femi Adeyemi
action: lying awake, thinking about his wife's hours
thought: I hope Simone's okay with her hours today.

speech.text: Hey, love. How're you feeling today?

event: The Harbor Bar is full and loud and for a few hours nothing is wrong.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: fidgets with paper on the desk
thought: If I just focus on this paperwork, I might not have to think about Lyle's smile.

speech.text: I think I've got the figures wrong on this report, can you take a look?

name: Junie Marsh
action: restocks the back bar, humming to herself
thought: I wonder if anyone would notice if I just walked out.

speech.text: Hey, Gus, how's it going?

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: reads a file, making notes
thought: What's going on with my dad, and why is everyone so secretive?

speech.text: Chidi, I think I found something interesting in that file.

name: Malik Reyes
action: sits in silence, staring at the ground
thought: I'm so tired of being used by everyone.

name: Rey Vasquez
action: signs for a delivery, checking the paperwork
thought: I just want to retire without any trouble.

name: Sticks
action: stands still, taking in his surroundings
thought: People see me, people care.

name: Chidi Okonkwo
action: listens to Nadia, nodding along
thought: I wish my brother would trust me with something real.

speech.text: Yeah, that's interesting.

name: Tiny Reyes
action: makes a mess with the coffee machine
thought: I want a bike.

speech.text: Nadia, can I get some help with this coffee machine?

name: Sgt. Hal Brennan
action: speaks on the phone, gesturing to Kohl
thought: If I just keep my head down, I might make it to the pension.

speech.text: Kohl, get the paperwork in order, we need to present it to Lyle.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: scans the paperwork, eyes narrowing
thought: I need to find a way to crack this case.

speech.text: What's the deal with this report, Kohl?

name: Fr. Emmanuel Boateng
action: listens attentively to Adaeze, taking notes
thought: I just want to help these young people before it's too late.

speech.text: Thank you for sharing this with me.

event: The block loses power for six hours. Everything happens in the dark.

name: Junie Marsh
action: Wipes down counter with a dirty rag
thought: Adeyemi would never understand why I'm still stuck here.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: Fidgets with his patrol belt
thought: I wonder if Lyle is watching me from across the block.

name: Sticks
action: Watches the snow fall, lost in thought
thought: Marcus Calloway is the only one who sees me as a person.

name: Gus Petrakis
action: Pours a cup of coffee for a customer
thought: Okonkwo is trying to take over, I can feel it.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: Steps forward in line, eyeing the cashier
thought: Calloway might be a worthy partner, but for now, she's just a means to an end.

name: Ms. Ivy Calloway
action: Rings up a sale for a customer
thought: Businessmen like Deveaux don't last long here.

name: Malik Reyes
action: Sits in the darkness, staring at nothing
thought: Okonkwo is working against me, I can feel it.

name: Rey Vasquez
action: Stands behind the counter, lost in thought
thought: My wife still loves me, I'm sure of it.

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: Tells a story at the table
thought: My father would never do anything to hurt anyone.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: Sips her drink, listening to the conversation
thought: Junie is telling the truth, I'm sure of it.

name: Chinedu Okafor
action: Restocks shelves, humming to himself
thought: Calloway has never once come into my store.

name: Malik Reyes
action: looks up from sitting down, catches Tee's eye
thought: I need to get out of here before I lose my train of thought, again.

speech.text: I'm gonna take a walk

name: Junie Marsh
action: watches TV, ignores Femi's questioning glance
thought: I need to get out of this place, but where would I go?

speech.text: nothing

name: Rey Vasquez
action: sits quietly, eyes on his phone
thought: I just need to get through the next few weeks, and then I'm done.

speech.text: nothing

action: polishes a glass, avoiding eye contact

speech.text: Can you get me another drink?

action: watches TV, glancing occasionally at Gus
thought: I just need to get out from under Lyle's thumb.

speech.text: You okay, Gus?

action: eats, occasionally reaching for Wes
thought: I just wish I could trust someone.

speech.text: Yeah, I'm good.

action: walks through the store, avoiding eye contact
thought: I just need to get out of this mess, before it's too late.

thought: Amara's going to be fine, she's a natural.

name: Sticks
action: sits quietly, eyes on the ground
thought: I just wish people saw me as a person, not just a nuisance.

action: looks around the room, avoiding eye contact
thought: I just need to stay under the radar, for now.

speech.text: Thanks, Dot.

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: looks at his phone, a hint of stress on his face
thought: I just need to keep my crew in line.

speech.text: I'll be home soon.
